citation: Hogue, J. (2019). Metro Interstate Traffic Volume. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C54S4P
monitored_corridor: Westbound Interstate 94 (I-94), Minneapolis - St. Paul, Minnesota, USA

raw_features.name: holiday
raw_features.description: US national holidays or regional holidays (e.g. State Fair), None otherwise

raw_features.name: rain_1h
raw_features.description: Amount in mm of rain that occurred in the hour

raw_features.name: snow_1h
raw_features.description: Amount in mm of snow that occurred in the hour

raw_features.name: weather_main
raw_features.description: Short textual description of the current weather (Clear, Clouds, Rain, Snow, etc.)

raw_features.name: weather_description
raw_features.description: Granular textual description of the current weather

raw_features.name: date_time
raw_features.description: Hour of the data collection in local CST/CDT time

geographic_note: The raw dataset does not provide row-level latitude and longitude coordinates. Monitored traffic corresponds to MN DOT ATR 301 on Westbound I-94.
